{{Top|leg}}
The '''blade power adjustment knob''' was a small knob located on the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that could be used to make the weapon's energy blade more or less powerful, to meet the need of the current circumstances. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] had one of these.
